reason: Task 2 passes its authored tests and basic CLI paths but fails required metric semantics, full-coverage reporting, computed-result verification, and interruption recovery.

classes.name: owned_tests_and_task1_regression
classes.outcome: Task 2: 7/7 passed; Task 1 regression: 62/62 passed; default Task 1 happy CLI remains AUDIT_COMPLETE.

classes.name: metric_numeric_semantics
classes.outcome: max_run_frac is computed from target (actual 0.25) rather than prediction (expected 0.75); no callable tau-a implementation exists; no-mask input emits NaN.

classes.name: prompt_mask_partition_and_seed

classes.name: pair_and_scalar_validation
classes.outcome: Missing panels, duplicate keys, mismatched pairs, malformed schema, and nonfinite values reject; boolean seed/value is accepted as true/1.0.

classes.name: failed_records_and_full_coverage
classes.outcome: failure=OOM with a finite metric is averaged as success; failed record without a metric invalidates the panel; 1/8 shards, n_records=999, and an incomplete declared grid are accepted.

classes.name: raw_cell_reconciliation

classes.name: metric_table_and_claim_scope
classes.outcome: Saved correction has no numeric masked-token-accuracy, tau-a, distinct-frac, or residue cells. Historical CI is clearly labeled descriptive (PASS). Sequence exact match is N/A because raw records contain no decoded targets/predictions and is correctly not fabricated.

classes.name: computed_result_and_receipt_truth
classes.outcome: Verifier returns METRICS_COMPLETE for delta=12345/pairs=999 tampering, empty corrections, schema_version=999, missing receipt, and missing Markdown.

classes.name: freshness_recovery_and_integrity
